buffer.lookup_text: MUTCD Table 6B-2: 645 ft. CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 14 posts a 570 ft minimum for the Case 26 step-down (65 → 60 mph), but Sheet 14 is drawn for shoulder work on a freeway or expressway and this road is neither, so the federal posted-speed value governs (Sheet 7 Case 11: buffer VARIES per General Note 24).

case.case: Case 11 (reduced work-zone speed): Shoulder closure on divided highway
case.narrative: This scenario matches CDOT Standard Plan S-630-1, Case 11: shoulder closure on a divided highway, with a reduced work-zone posted speed (65 → 60 mph) that is the Case 26/27 step-down, but Sheet 14 draws Cases 26/27 for freeway/expressway only. Fines Double envelope applies per S-630-1 Sheet 12, Fines Double Signing Notes.
case.narrative_2: CDOT S-630-1 draws no reduced-speed shoulder typical for this road. The advance signs follow MUTCD 11th Ed. Table 6B-1 at 65 mph, and the buffer follows MUTCD Table 6B-2 at the posted speed.

fines_double.citation: CDOT S-630-1 (July 2026) Sheet 12, Fines Double Signing Notes

operational_notes.action: Install Fines Double signs no more than 4 hours before the start of the work day. Do not leave signs up overnight when work is not active.
Remove or cover Fines Double signs when work concludes; doubled fines apply only when workers or work activity are present in the zone.
Relocate the R2-10/R2-11 envelope to follow the actual work area as the project progresses; do not leave Fines Double signs in place beyond the active work zone.
Maintain a 250 ft minimum spacing between Fines Double signs (R2-10, R2-11, G20-5P/R2-6P assemblies) and other warning or regulatory signs. Engineer may adjust placement to satisfy this minimum.
